name: Bodyguard
description: When an ally within arm's reach is hit by an attack, you can choose to take the damage instead. The decision must be made before the attack roll is resolved.

name: Compassion
description: When you spend a slow action comforting a broken ally, roll Empathy. For each success, the ally recovers one point of Resolve.

name: Fast Reflexes
description: You draw two initiative cards at the start of each combat and keep whichever you prefer.

name: Field Surgeon
description: You can treat critical injuries without a proper doctor's bag. You still roll Healing, but the lack of equipment does not impose a negative modifier.

name: Flyweight
description: You are not encumbered by carrying heavy loads the way others are. Your Mobility skill is never penalized due to encumbrance.

name: Gut Feeling
description: Once per game session, you may ask the GM one yes or no question about an immediate danger or threat. The GM must answer honestly.

name: Hardened
description: You have steeled yourself against the horrors of the world. Increase your maximum Resolve by 1 per rank. Can be taken up to 3 times.

name: Hard Hitter
description: Your attacks hit with brutal force. When you roll an attack, your weapon's base damage is increased by 1.

name: Healer
description: You have a gift for mending wounds. When you successfully heal someone using the Healing skill, the patient recovers one extra point of Health.

name: Inquisitive
description: Your mind is sharp and analytical. When investigating a scene or mystery, you may reroll one die in your dice pool that did not show a 6. You must keep the new result.

name: Killer
description: You are relentless in a fight. When you push an attack roll, add one extra die to the re-roll pool.

name: Lucky
description: Fortune favors you. Once per session, after making a roll, you may reroll all dice that did not show a 6. You are not exposed to bane effects from this second roll.

name: Menacing
description: Your presence is terrifying. When you attempt to intimidate or threaten someone, they treat you as one step more hostile than you actually are.

name: Merciless
description: You fight without hesitation or restraint. When you push an attack roll, any banes on gear dice do not apply — your weapon does not degrade from the push.

name: Musician
description: You can use music to ease suffering. When you play an instrument and roll Empathy, for each success one ally who hears you recovers one point of Resolve.

name: Pack Mule
description: You can carry two extra items beyond the normal encumbrance limit before suffering any penalties.

name: Quick Draw
description: You can draw or ready a weapon as a free action rather than a fast action.

name: Reckless
description: You throw yourself into danger without hesitation. When you push a roll, add one extra die — but you must accept all bane effects that result, without exception.

name: Second Wind
description: You recover quickly under pressure. Once per combat encounter, as a free action, you may regain 1 point of Health.

name: Sniper
description: You are trained for long-range engagements. You may fire at Long or Extreme range without suffering the normal range penalty.

name: Tough
description: Your body can take more punishment than most. Increase your maximum Health by 1 per rank. Can be taken up to 3 times.

name: True Grit
description: When you suffer a critical injury, you may reroll one die of the D66 roll. You must accept the new result.

name: Weapon Specialist
description: You have mastered a specific weapon type (choose one: axe, sword, knife, pistol, carbine, etc.). You get +1 bonus die when attacking with that weapon type. Can be taken once per weapon type — take it multiple times to specialize in additional weapons.
